title: 5 Fastest Cars On Earth — Number 1 Is Terrifying
narration:
These mind-blowing hypercars push human engineering to the absolute limit. You will not believe how fast they run. But number one goes so ridiculously fast, it feels almost terrifying...

Starting off at number five... we have the Rimac Nevera! This all-electric monster packs four motors that unleash nearly two thousand horsepower. It shoots from zero to sixty miles per hour in under two seconds... That makes it faster off the line than a modern Formula One race car!

Coming in at number four... it is the insane Hennessey Venom F5! Built in Texas, this terrifying machine houses a twin-turbo engine with over eighteen hundred horsepower. It is built out of carbon fiber and was engineered specifically to crush three hundred miles per hour...

Sliding into the number three spot... the sleek SSC Tuatara! This aerodynamic masterpiece weighs less than a tiny compact car while generating incredible speed. It reached proven test speeds of nearly three hundred miles per hour... Its smooth body cuts through the air like a razor blade.

At number two... the world-famous Bugatti Chiron Super Sport! This four-million-dollar land rocket became the first official road car to break three hundred miles per hour. It burns through an entire tank of gasoline in under ten minutes when pushing at its absolute top speed...

And finally... sitting at number one... the utterly terrifying Koenigsegg Jesko Absolut! This Swedish speed demon is computer-designed to soar past three hundred and ten miles per hour... It features long rear fins inspired by fighter jets to maintain stability. Nothing on four wheels matches this level of pure speed!

Which of these crazy hypercars would you dare to drive at top speed? Drop your ranking in the comments below!

title: 5 Largest Volcanoes On Earth — Number 1 Is Terrifying 🌋
narration: Deep beneath our feet, nature hides monsters so massive they can crush the ocean floor. Number one on this list is so unimaginably huge, its sheer weight bends the Earth's tectonic plate... At number 5, Mount Kilimanjaro. Rising nearly 6,000 meters above the plains of Africa, this giant holds icy glaciers right near the hot equator. It is so tall, it creates its own weather system. At number 4, Yellowstone Supervolcano. Hidden underneath an entire national park, this underground monster spans nearly 70 kilometers across. A super-eruption could bury half of North America under thick, deadly ash. At number 3, Tamu Massif. Resting deep beneath the Pacific Ocean, this extinct giant covers an area almost as big as the British Isles. It spans over 300,000 square kilometers on the seafloor. At number 2, Pūhāhonu. Hidden in the Hawaiian ocean chain, this shield volcano holds nearly 150,000 cubic kilometers of rock. It is twice the volume of Mauna Loa, with burning hot magma deep inside. And at number 1, Mauna Loa. Rising over 9,000 meters from the ocean floor, this active giant covers more than half of Hawaii. Its terrifying weight literally forces the ocean floor miles deep into the Earth. Which of these giant monsters scares you the most? Tell us your ranking in the comments!

title: 5 Largest Stadiums Ever Built — Number 1 Is Terrifying 🏟️
narration: Human beings love building massive arenas, but the single largest stadium on Earth is so big it feels almost terrifying... Starting at number 5... Ohio Stadium. Located in the United States, this gigantic venue can hold over 100,000 screaming fans at once. The entire building is shaped like a giant horseshoe to squeeze in more seats. At number 4... Beaver Stadium. This massive college arena can fit nearly 107,000 people inside its walls. The crowd noise during big games is so loud that it can actually trigger earthquake sensors. Coming in at number 3... Michigan Stadium. Famous around the world as The Big House, it comfortably seats over 107,000 spectators. It is so gigantic that passengers can easily spot it from airplane windows high in the sky. At number 2... May Day Stadium. Built in North Korea, this colossal structure seats over 114,000 people inside. Its massive roof looks like sixteen giant flower petals curving over the crowd. And at number 1... Narendra Modi Stadium. Built in India, this giant arena holds a mind-blowing 132,000 people. Standing on the field feels like sitting at the bottom of a giant ocean of human voices. Which of these massive stadiums would you dare to enter first? Tell us your pick in the comments below!
